async def run(items, step):
    serial = in_order
    # ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-python
    await serial(items, step)
    await serial(items, step, reason="Each update reads the previous write")
    value = None
    for item in items:
        if value is None:
            value = await load()
        if values[item] is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            values[item] = await load(item)
